snippet.title: Wagie Run Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wagie Run is a runner game inspired by Pepsi-Man. You play as an employee, running from his neighborhood towards his office. Don't be late for work! dodge obstacles and keep on the caffeine intakes, to make sure you'll arrive on time. Developed by "Apple & Clover", who for now consist only of a single solo developer named "Haybrid".

Coming soon to PC.

Music:
Elsewhere - Jim Hall
https://freemusicarchive.org/music/jim-hall/synth-kid-elsewhere/elsewhere/
Minor edits were made to the music, to match the video's length and tempo.
